proposals.explanation: The script renames the two-argument beginAnalyzeDocument/beginAnalyzeBatchDocuments/beginClassifyDocument parameters to options objects, replaces their bodies to null-check the options and delegate to the full overload with unpacked getters (joining pages with a comma), and rewrites Javadoc.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The bodies and Javadoc are written by a class extending Customization via setBody/setJavadocComment AST edits.

proposals.explanation: The script removes the public modifier from beginAnalyzeDocument, beginAnalyzeBatchDocuments and beginClassifyDocument overloads that take outputContentFormat or split parameters.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: removeModifier(PUBLIC) calls in a Customization script change visibility of generated methods.

proposals.explanation: The script clears modifiers on the default/String constructors and on setUrlSource, setBytesSource, setAzureBlobSource and setAzureBlobFileListSource of the three options classes, hiding them from the public API.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: NodeWithModifiers::setModifiers calls in the customization script alter the generated models.

proposals.explanation: The options models expose public constructors taking a URL string, bytes, or blob source plus result container URL with null checks.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The constructors are plain members (no @Generated visible) and replace the hidden default constructors.

proposals.explanation: AnalyzeBatchDocumentsOptions exposes fluent getters/setters (queryFields, outputContentFormat, output, stringIndexType, pages, locale, features) used by the convenience overloads.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Accessors are un-annotated members with handwritten Javadoc in the options model that the script unpacks.

proposals.explanation: The script removes @Immutable from AnalyzeOperationDetails and adds an operationId field, a public getResultId() getter and a private setOperationId().
proposals.handwrittenRationale: addField/addMethod and removal of the Immutable annotation in the script; resulting members lack @Generated.

proposals.explanation: The script injects a static initializer into AnalyzeOperationDetails registering an AnalyzeOperationDetailsAccessor so implementation code can call the private setOperationId.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The initializer is AST-inserted and the helper class is a plain implementation class with the standard accessor pattern.

proposals.explanation: The script adds poll overrides to OperationLocationPollingStrategy and SyncOperationLocationPollingStrategy that call super.poll, parse the operation ID from the Operation-Location header, and set it on AnalyzeOperationDetails.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: addMethod with Override and a custom body appended to generated polling strategies.

proposals.explanation: The script adds a regex PATTERN field and PollingUtils.parseOperationId, extracting the operation ID from the last path segment of the Operation-Location URL.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: Field and method are added to the generated PollingUtils through AST edits and the regex hardcodes a service path.

proposals.explanation: The script removes four generated sample files that use the old overloads.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: removeFile calls in the script delete generated files.

decisions.reason: Lines 64-135 of the Customization script rename the request parameter, replace the body with a null check and delegation to the full overload with unpacked option getters, and rewrite Javadoc for all three operations on both clients (customizeImpl applied at lines 60-61). The cited range also includes the hide-overload edits covered by a separate proposal.
Lines 87-89, 114-116 and 137-139 call removeModifier(PUBLIC) on overloads with outputContentFormat or split parameters; distinct from the body rewrite.
Lines 144-169 call setModifiers() with no modifiers on the default/String constructors and source setters of the three options models, making them package-private.

The constructors are shown without @Generated and are not added by the script, so they are inline handwritten members; but the proposal omitted the byte[] and BinaryData constructors listed or present in the evidence (AnalyzeDocumentOptions(byte[]) was named in symbols without evidence). Revised to cite all of them.

finding.explanation: The options models expose public constructors taking a URL string, byte[], BinaryData (converted to bytes), or a blob/file-list source plus result container URL with null checks, replacing the hidden generated constructors.
finding.rootCauseHypothesis: Hypothesis: the generated request-body models only offered a no-arg constructor plus setters for mutually exclusive sources, so typed constructors were handwritten.
finding.handwrittenRationale: No @Generated annotation appears between the Javadoc and the constructor declarations, and the customization script does not add them (it only hides the generated default/String constructors).

decisions.reason: The same un-annotated fluent accessors for operation parameters (pages, locale, stringIndexType, features, queryFields, output, outputContentFormat, split) exist in AnalyzeDocumentOptions and ClassifyDocumentOptions too, and the script's convenience bodies unpack them from all three models; the proposal cited only AnalyzeBatchDocumentsOptions. Revised to cover all three models and the varargs setDocumentAnalysisFeatures overload; pattern renamed to describe the shape (operation parameters folded into an options model).

finding.subtype: Operation parameters added to options models
finding.explanation: AnalyzeDocumentOptions, AnalyzeBatchDocumentsOptions and ClassifyDocumentOptions carry handwritten fluent getters/setters for operation query parameters (pages, locale, stringIndexType, documentAnalysisFeatures incl. a varargs overload, queryFields, output, outputContentFormat, split) that the convenience overloads unpack.
finding.rootCauseHypothesis: Hypothesis: the generator produced separate query parameters on the operation rather than an options bag, so the parameters were folded into the body model by hand.
finding.handwrittenRationale: The accessors appear without @Generated and with handwritten Javadoc; they are not request-body properties of the generated model but are consumed by the script-written convenience bodies (script lines 69-75, 95-101, 122-123).

decisions.reason: Script lines 171-192 remove @Immutable, add the operationId field, public getResultId() and private setOperationId(); resulting members appear in AnalyzeOperationDetails at 195-197 and 204-206.

Script lines 35-48 insert a static initializer registering the accessor (visible at AnalyzeOperationDetails 183-186); AnalyzeOperationDetailsHelper is a plain implementation class without generation markers.

The poll overrides are real script additions (lines 217-268), but the code does not unwrap the LRO result; it enriches each poll response with the operation ID parsed from the Operation-Location header. Pattern renamed and aligned with the related PollingUtils parsing finding; end line extended to the closing brace at 268.

finding.explanation: The script adds poll overrides to OperationLocationPollingStrategy and SyncOperationLocationPollingStrategy that call super.poll, parse the operation ID from the stored Operation-Location header, and set it on AnalyzeOperationDetails via the accessor helper.
finding.rootCauseHypothesis: Hypothesis: the service returns the result ID only in the Operation-Location URL, and the generator has no way to surface a header-derived value on the poll result model.
finding.handwrittenRationale: addMethod with @Override and a custom body appended to the generated polling strategy classes in a class extending Customization.

decisions.reason: Real script edit (lines 194-215), but it is one half of the same behavior as the poll override finding, so it should share the pattern name; generatorAddressable 'no' is not justified merely because the regex hardcodes a path, since a generator could expose a header-derived ID generically, so changed to unclear.

finding.explanation: The script adds a regex PATTERN field and PollingUtils.parseOperationId, extracting the operation ID from the last path segment of the Operation-Location URL.
finding.rootCauseHypothesis: Hypothesis: no TypeSpec construct maps a segment of the Operation-Location header onto the poll result model.
finding.handwrittenRationale: Field and method are added to the generated PollingUtils through addFieldWithInitializer/addMethod AST edits in a Customization class.

decisions.reason: Lines 50-56 only delete generated sample files under src/samples; the Java guidelines exclude tests and samples, and this changes no library API or behavior.
